mandatory_legal_checks: Contract Act 1872 S.10 — whether a term sheet binds is decided on its terms; the binding/non-binding split must be explicit and consistent
Companies Act 2013 S.42 and S.62(1)(c) — the issue requires the prescribed resolutions and a registered valuer's report
Income-tax Act S.56(2)(viib) — angel tax ABOLISHED from 1 April 2025 for all investors including non-residents
Income-tax Act S.56(2)(x) — unaffected by that abolition; charges the RECIPIENT of shares issued below fair value
IBC 2016 S.53 — a liquidation preference ranks only among shareholders and cannot displace creditors
Option pool in the PRE-money capitalisation dilutes founders alone; state which is intended
